verdict.rationale: Name.com documents an official MCP server that lets AI agents such as Cursor and Claude Desktop call Core API operations on the user's behalf. It also offers a separate read-only MCP server for searching its API documentation, and a probe confirmed the MCP doc page exists. missing for 10: detailed setup, auth and tool-list documentation in the evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration of the server working.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The name.com Model Context Protocol (MCP) server lets AI agents (e.g., Cursor, Claude Desktop) safely call name.com Core API operations on your behalf.
Read‑only MCP server that lets agents search and cite the name.com Core API documentation in chat.
